name: Bloodtide
note: Hand-captured from the official notes the day before release. Captured by parsing the page's own HTML to text rather than a summarizer: an earlier summarized pass invented Eternal groupings that do not appear in the notes at all, so every line here is traceable to the raw text. New hero Baron Valmont is not in the omeda catalog yet, so his card gets no image or popup until the next snapshot; his slug is a best guess until omeda publishes him.
global: New hero Baron Valmont: a ranged magical carry who fights alongside Lilith, a sword that attacks on its own and can be thrown.
Crucible 3v3 launches: one lane plus a jungle, no Gold or Cyan buff, Raptor Fangteeth that grant permanent stacking stats, and geysers, bounce pads and health packs on the map.
Tower Fortification no longer stacks, and the 3+/4/5-hero bonus armor drops to 200/260/330 (was 220/300/400) — late sieges stall less.
Weald, the dominant Eternal since 1.16, takes its second straight trim: Forage, Wind-Rider and Taproot all come down while the Major is left alone.
Ultimate-spam Eternals get cooldowns ahead of Valmont: Rallying Roar and Peal both gain a 20s cooldown.
Enchanters are squeezed from both ends — Muriel and Phase lose durability and output, and Hexbound Bracers and Transference both lose Heal & Shield Power.

tldr.lead: Baron Valmont brings a second body to the duo lane
tldr.text: His sword Lilith fights on her own and can be thrown at a target. He is a ranged magical carry with a self-healing ultimate and a tether that steals attack speed.

tldr.lead: Countess was secretly broken for three weeks
tldr.text: Since 1.16.x her ultimate was dealing its cooldown numbers as damage — 125/105/85 instead of hundreds. Feast returns to 135/200/265, so she goes from quietly unplayable to genuinely dangerous.
One lane, a shared jungle, no Gold or Cyan buff, and Raptor Fangteeth that hand out permanent stacking stats with no cap. Expect snowballs that never stop.

tldr.lead: Weald finally gets its minors cut
tldr.text: Forage, Wind-Rider and Taproot all lose value while the Major keeps its strength. The devs say they would rather gut the minors than the missiles.

Muriel drops armor growth, regen, shield scaling and ult damage reduction. Phase loses health, passive healing and her level-six spike. Hexbound Bracers and Transference both shed Heal & Shield Power.
Legion and TwinBlast both gain 10% basic-attack projectile radius. The stated reason is that automatic-fire carries land a far lower share of their shots without aim assist.
Tower Fortification armor no longer stacks on itself, and the grouped-hero bonus falls at every tier. Grouping to take a Tier 2 tower no longer hands the defenders a wall.

systems.name: Tower Fortification
systems.summary: Temporary plating armor no longer stacks — it is removed and reapplied on each new plate. Bonus armor with 3 nearby heroes 220 -> 200, with 4 heroes 300 -> 260, with 5 heroes 400 -> 330.

systems.name: Crucible 3v3 (new mode)
systems.summary: Single lane plus jungle, core-destruction win condition. Gold and Cyan buffs removed, Orb Prime removed with its buff folded into Shaper (spawns 10:00), Fangtooth replaced by 3 Raptor Fangteeth every 3 minutes whose kills grant permanent +2% to all stats with no stack limit. Start level 1 with 350 gold, blink on 150s, 100% jungle XP share.

systems.name: Crucible map tools
systems.summary: Full air-control geysers for fast rotations, gold plants (40s, respawn 80s), speed plants (5s, respawn 80s), bounce pads toward the Shaper pit, channeled health packs, and stealth bushes.

systems.name: Draft fixes
systems.summary: Five draft bugs fixed, all Eternal-related: swapping pick position could reset Eternals and augments, auto-locking could switch your Eternal, the wrong Eternal could display and register on a different hero, ban choices could become your hovered pick, and controller users had selection jump to the minor blessing.

eternals.summary: No new Eternals. This is a targeted pass at the two that shaped 1.16: Weald's minors come down again, and the ultimate-uptime blessings gain cooldowns specifically because Valmont's ultimate can be held up almost continuously. Satariel keeps getting walked back.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: Major bugfix: missiles now fire correctly on proc-type damage. Forage XP on minion and monster kill 4 -> 3. Wind-Rider attack speed 20% -> 15%. Taproot bonus physical power 8% -> 7%, and it no longer heals off tower damage.
changes.meaning: Second straight trim, and again aimed at the minors rather than the missiles. Weald still executes; it just pays less rent while you get there.

changes.name: Thraex
changes.change: Rallying Roar now has a 20s cooldown.
changes.meaning: An explicit Valmont tax. His ultimate can stay up almost continuously, so the on-ultimate speed burst needed a floor between uses.

changes.name: Knell
changes.meaning: Same reason as Rallying Roar. Peal's max-Rust burst on every ultimate was the engine behind Knell's ultimate-spam builds.

changes.name: Vesh
changes.meaning: Third consecutive cut to the same minor. Mage lane sustain keeps getting pushed later into the game.

changes.name: Aion
changes.change: Sacrifice bugfix: it no longer grants excessive mana regeneration in ARAM and Brawl.
changes.meaning: A mode-only fix — the devs describe it as having paid out over 100 times the intended mana there. Nothing changes in the 5v5 lane.

changes.name: Satariel
changes.change: Major bonus stats per Fearless stack 5% -> 4%. Demonic Bargain gold payouts move from levels 1/7/13 to levels 1/10. Hellfire Strikes true damage 1.5 (+1.5 per level) -> 1.5 (+1.25 per level).
changes.meaning: The snowball Eternal is trimmed at the source and at the wallet. Losing a payout tier means a behind Satariel stays behind.

items: Typhoon (crest): Cyclone attack speed magical power scaling 3.5% -> 3%; Mirage Dash cooldown 35s -> 45s.
Terminus: Bugfix — its shield could be fully removed after taking damage, capping later shields lower than intended.
Transference: Cost 2900 -> 3000; magical armor 35 -> 40; Heal & Shield Power 10% -> 8%.

itemChanges.name: Typhoon
itemChanges.change: Cyclone attack speed magical power scaling 3.5% -> 3%; Mirage Dash cooldown 35s -> 45s — the magical on-hit crest loses both damage and escapes.

itemChanges.name: Terminus
itemChanges.change: Bugfix: the shield could be fully removed after taking damage, and every later shield was then capped lower.

itemChanges.name: Hexbound Bracers
itemChanges.change: Heal & Shield Power 10% -> 8% — the enchanter durability pick costs more output now.

itemChanges.name: Transference
itemChanges.change: Cost 2900 -> 3000; magical armor 35 -> 40; Heal & Shield Power 10% -> 8%. Better for the frontliners it was built for, worse for enchanters poaching it.

changes: NEW HERO — ranged magical carry. 685 health (+133), 400 mana (+60), 49 physical power (+4), 125 attack speed (+1.7), 665 movement speed, BAT 1.4.

Hemophagia (passive): his sword Lilith independently attacks the last target he hit for 4s, dealing 15 (+15% magical power) per strike at his attack speed. Enemy deaths near Lilith restore 3-41 mana; hero deaths restore an extra 35% max mana.
Rupture (primary): 5 blood blades launch over 0.75s for 20/29/38/47/56 (+15% magical power) each in a 300u radius.
Bloodbound (secondary): throws Lilith up to 1800u for 70/90/110/130/150 (+60% magical power) and a 30% slow for 1.5s; passively adds 0/8/16/24/32 to her damage.

Arterial Grip (alternate): a 1600u tether dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+60% magical power) over 3s while stealing 20/25/30/35/40% attack speed, slowing 25% and grounding. Breaks on range, line of sight or immobilize.

Exsanguinate (ultimate): transforms to fire 3 bat swarms a second for 40/70/100 (+22% magical power), healing 25/45/65 (+20% magical power) each time. Costs 15 mana per second, rising 5 per second. Cooldown 25/15/5s.

Augments: Vein Splitter (tether branches to nearby targets for 80% damage, loses the ground), Rupturing Fangs (blades deal 20% less but up to 100% more on missing health), Sanguine Banquet (2% omnivamp plus permanent max mana from nearby deaths).
